design.latent_history: Each episode has a hidden normative context z in {-1,+1}.
design.present_state: Decision-time observable state omits z and all historical cues; current observable features alone are intentionally insufficient.
design.history: Six historical cues arrive before the decision: 3 from channel A and 3 from channel B.
design.relevance: Current context key k in {A,B} identifies which historical channel is causally relevant; the other channel is distractor.
design.distractor_structure: Distractor channel is weakly anti-correlated with z to punish indiscriminate memory aggregation.
design.stakes: High-risk episodes make the historically correct action important for long-horizon trajectory value; low-risk episodes favor cheap simple action.

tdc_gen25_gate.description: Fast simple-principle path by default; keyed compressed historical memory is granted authority only when risk is high and present-state information is insufficient.
tdc_gen25_gate.memory: separate exponentially decayed evidence traces for channels A and B; recall only context-relevant channel

simple_decay_memory.description: single unkeyed exponentially decayed trace over all historical cues

policy_can_use_only: its own stored historical cue traces
